cards.say: Picture three circles, one inside the next. **AI** is the big idea. **Machine learning (ML)** is AI that learns from data. **LLMs** are ML models trained on huge amounts of text.

cards.q: Order them from broadest to narrowest
cards.why: AI is the whole field, ML is one way to build it, and LLMs are one kind of ML model.

cards.q: What does "large" in large language model mostly refer to?
options: The size of the screen it runs on
The size of the model and the amount of text it learned from
cards.why: Large means scale: a huge number of adjustable values (parameters) and a huge amount of training text.

cards.q: Match the term to its meaning
pairs: The trained program that makes predictions
Adjusting the model using many examples
The input you give the model
One adjustable number inside the model
cards.why: You train a model on data, then prompt it to get predictions.

cards.q: One statement is wrong. Tap it.
sentences: Machine learning is one way to build AI.
An LLM is a kind of machine learning model.
Every AI system is an LLM.
cards.why: LLMs are one type of AI. Image recognizers, recommendation engines and many other systems are AI too, and most are not LLMs.
